en.headline: Sui and Tang attire exhibition opens at Central Library
en.dek: Free show at Hong Kong Central Library runs until 6 September, blending reconstructed historical clothing with contemporary fashion and digital displays.
body: A free exhibition exploring clothing culture from the Sui and Tang dynasties is now on at Hong Kong Central Library, organised as part of the Chinese Culture Festival 2026.

Titled Echoes of the Sui & Tang: Ancient Attire and Modern Design, the display occupies Exhibition Gallery 1-5 on the ground floor and features reconstructed historical attire, contemporary fashion pieces inspired by the era, and digital presentations of Sui-Tang culture. It is presented by the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles Hong Kong Member Association with the Central Academy of Fine Arts.
Opening hours are 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. from Friday to Sunday until 6 September. Guided tours and workshops are scheduled across the coming days, including sessions this Saturday. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 隋唐服飾展於中央圖書館舉行 免費入場至9月6日
zh.dek: 中國文化節活動於香港中央圖書館展覽廊展出復原古裝、當代時裝及數碼展示，融合歷史與現代設計。
body: 中國文化節2026活動「隋唐迴響：古裝與現代設計」展覽現於香港中央圖書館地下展覽廊1至5號舉行，免費入場。
展覽由中國文聯香港會員總會主辦，中央美術學院協辦，分為三個主題部分，包括復原隋唐服飾、當代時裝創作，以及數碼化隋唐文化展示，並設衍生產品。
展期由8月28日至9月6日，開放時間為上午10時至晚上8時。本周六有導賞及工作坊，公眾可於中央圖書館查詢詳情。
